$comment: The registry of libraries under test. `status` is the state of the ADAPTER, not the library's accessibility. `published` means every failure has been confirmed against the DOM by hand; `draft` means measured but not verified, and must never be cited.

targets.name: React Spectrum
targets.notes: Calibration control. Widely regarded as the accessibility gold standard, and measured first so that a failure it produces is presumed to be a fault in our assertion. Scores 100% on all five components.

targets.name: Radix UI
targets.notes: Reference adapter implementation. Read this one first when writing a new adapter. Ships no combobox primitive, which is recorded as n/a rather than zero.

targets.name: shadcn/ui
targets.notes: Generated with shadcn@4.16.1 on 2026-08-04 rather than installed, so it is identified by CLI version and generation date. Dialog, menu, tabs and accordion are Radix; the combobox is Base UI.

targets.name: MUI
targets.notes: Failures verified against the DOM. MUI ships the behaviour and leaves several ARIA relationships to the developer, which its documentation instructs you to write yourself. Tab panels come from @mui/lab because @mui/material exports none.

targets.name: Chakra UI
targets.notes: Chakra v3, built on Ark UI. Failures verified against the DOM.

targets.name: Ant Design
targets.notes: NOT PUBLISHABLE. First-run scores were dominated by adapter bugs of ours: combobox moved 27% -> 94% and accordion 42% -> 85% after correcting a visibility check and a v5 class name. Remaining failures are unverified — see docs/DECISIONS.md 016 for exactly which are confirmed and which are still open.

targets.name: Headless UI
targets.notes: Failures verified against the DOM. Headless UI ships no accordion component, only Disclosure, so its section headers have no heading wrapper.
